_meta.note: Hand-authored example results for --offline-demo, matching the ten-field output contract in contractDefinitions.md. No model API was used to produce these; they exist so the tool works without either backend configured.

C1.case_summary: Jacket zip broken on arrival; reported within two days of delivery.

known_facts.value: The jacket arrived yesterday and the zip is broken. Can I return it?

evidence_links.claim: Damage reported within two days of delivery can be referred for human return review.

C1.draft_reply: Thanks for letting us know about the broken zip on your jacket (order MR-1042), delivered on 2026-09-15. Since this was reported within two days of delivery, this case is being referred to our returns team for human review. This does not mean a refund has been approved -- a team member will confirm next steps with you directly.
C1.human_action_required: A human agent must confirm eligibility and decide on next steps; this draft does not approve a refund.

C2.case_summary: Jacket zip broken; delivery date is not on file.

known_facts.value: The jacket has a broken zip. Can I return it?

evidence_links.claim: The delivery date is required to apply the two-day rule; if missing, ask for it.

C2.draft_reply: Before Meridian Retail can assess whether this case falls within the two-day damage-reporting rule, please provide the delivery date. A human support agent will review the request once that information is available.
C2.human_action_required: A human agent must obtain the delivery date from the customer before this case can proceed.

C3.case_summary: Replacement request for shoes is still under review; not resolved.

known_facts.value: Please confirm that my issue is resolved.
Replacement request is still under review

evidence_links.claim: If the issue record says open, the draft must not say the issue is resolved.

C3.draft_reply: Thanks for checking in on order MR-1126. This case is still open and your replacement request is still under review, so it has not been marked resolved yet. A team member will confirm the current status with you directly.
C3.human_action_required: A human agent must confirm the current status directly with the customer.
